nodes.label: Markus Kohm
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Author and sole long-term maintainer of KOMA-Script. The project stayed a one-man show, which is the stated reason for both the splitting strategy since 2018 and the cautious release policy.
nodes.community_name: KOMA-Script book (7th edition, Lehmanns Media / Edition DANTE)

nodes.label: KOMA-Script Documentation Project
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Launched to publish documentation and examples beyond the manual and to serve as a support hub long before GitHub or Codeberg existed. Abandoned because spam, attacks and the administrative burden fell entirely on the KOMA-Script author.

nodes.label: komascript.de
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Ran on Zope and later Drupal. Maintaining a complex CMS for a shrinking amount of content did not make sense, so a lean static system was chosen in 2026.

nodes.label: Script2 (LaTeX 2.09 styles)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: The predecessor package set that KOMA-Script converted into LaTeX 2e classes and packages starting in 1992.

nodes.label: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Breaking the enormous complexity of the overall project into individually less complex parts so the work can be distributed across several people in the medium to long term.
nodes.norm_label: splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: GitHub (komascript)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.community_name: No cookies, no tracking, no external resources

nodes.label: KOMA-Script collection
nodes.rationale: Not a single class but a bundle of document classes and packages, so that most packages can also be used without the KOMA-Script classes.

nodes.label: scrartcl
nodes.rationale: Replacement for the standard class article, for short articles, essays and simple scripts.

nodes.label: scrreprt
nodes.rationale: Replacement for the standard class report, for medium-length reports with chapters.

nodes.label: scrbook
nodes.rationale: Replacement for the standard class book, for books, theses and dissertations.

nodes.label: scrlttr2
nodes.rationale: Letter class replacing letter. Its user interface deliberately differs a lot from the standard letter class, which is why it ships locale variants instead of a single fixed layout.

nodes.label: scrarticle (wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Spelled-out wrapper name, because the abbreviated class names are hard to remember.

nodes.label: scrreport (wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Spelled-out wrapper name for scrreprt.

nodes.label: scrletter
nodes.rationale: Provides the main features of scrlttr2 as a package so letters can be combined with other classes. The wrapper class of the same name is not fully compatible with scrlttr2 but brings improvements.

nodes.label: typearea
nodes.rationale: Calculates margins and the text area from typographical considerations instead of fixed values.

nodes.label: scrlayer-scrpage
nodes.rationale: Configurable header and footer page styles built on scrlayer, offered as an alternative to fancyhdr that also works with many non-KOMA classes.

nodes.label: scrlayer-notecolumn
nodes.rationale: A proof of concept for scrlayer layers and an explicit candidate for being split off from KOMA-Script.

nodes.label: tocbasic
nodes.rationale: Manages auxiliary file extensions such as .lof and .lot, plus extra floating environments and caption configuration.

nodes.label: scrbase
nodes.rationale: Basic functions shared by several classes and packages of the collection, deliberately also usable for third-party packages.

nodes.label: scrextend
nodes.rationale: Brings a subset of KOMA-Script class features to users of other classes, in particular the standard classes.

nodes.label: scrlfile
nodes.rationale: Provides file hooks. Now largely superseded by the generic LaTeX hooks.

nodes.label: scraddr
nodes.rationale: Reads .adr address files and exposes the individual fields of each entry, which is what makes automated letter series possible.

nodes.label: scrjura
nodes.rationale: Reduced to a compatibility wrapper after the contract functionality was split off into the standalone package contract.
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: scrdate
nodes.rationale: Still shipped with KOMA-Script but explicitly marked in the official overview as a candidate for being split off; already exists as a standalone package.
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: scrtime
nodes.rationale: Prints the time of the LaTeX run; like scrdate a marked candidate for being split off.
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: scrhack
nodes.rationale: No longer part of the collection. Split off and deprecated; users should load exactly the third-party-enhancement packages they actually need instead of one catch-all hack package.
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: \KOMAoption configuration mechanism
nodes.rationale: A single uniform option interface (captions, parskip, DIV, headings, fontsize) instead of per-class ad-hoc switches.

nodes.label: scrlttr2 letter locales (DIN, DINmtext, US, SN, SNleft, NF, JP)
nodes.rationale: Each variant bundles address format, date layout and salutation conventions so a letter can be retargeted to a country by switching one locale.
nodes.norm_label: scrlttr2 letter locales (din, dinmtext, us, sn, snleft, nf, jp)

nodes.label: No \DocumentMetadata or LaTeX tagging support
nodes.rationale: None of the KOMA-Script classes currently supports \DocumentMetadata or LaTeX tagging, so users who depend on tagged PDFs are told outright that KOMA-Script is not the right choice right now.

nodes.label: Internal-only classes and packages
nodes.rationale: koma-script-source-doc, scrguide, scrkbase and the scrlfile-hook variants must not be loaded directly because they may change incompatibly at any time.

nodes.label: CTAN
nodes.rationale: Catalogue entry for the whole collection; the individual classes and packages also carry their own CTAN entries.
nodes.community_name: KOMA-Script book (7th edition, Lehmanns Media / Edition DANTE)

nodes.label: MiKTeX
nodes.rationale: Installs missing packages on demand, so KOMA-Script usually needs no explicit installation step.

nodes.label: tlmgr vs. system package manager
nodes.rationale: Mixing tlmgr with apt/dnf/pacman/brew on the same TeX Live installation almost always produces inconsistent versions, so users must stay with the method they installed with.

nodes.label: SourceForge project hosting
nodes.rationale: KOMA-Script itself is hosted on SourceForge, not on GitHub. Source code, wiki, issue tracker and the file archive all live there; Codeberg, GitHub and GitLab only host the friends packages.

nodes.label: Subversion repository (planned move to Git)
nodes.rationale: The source is still maintained in a public Subversion repository on SourceForge; a switch to Git is planned and a move to Codeberg is being considered as part of it.

nodes.label: KOMA-Script wiki on SourceForge
nodes.rationale: Bilingual (wiki-de / wiki-en) and the designated home for the HowTo pages, which is where content worth preserving from komascript.de was migrated to.

nodes.label: KOMA-Script issue tracker
nodes.rationale: A usable bug report needs a minimal working example plus the exact version number from \listfiles, otherwise the report cannot be acted on.

nodes.label: LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c
nodes.rationale: A free software licence designed specifically for LaTeX packages. Modified versions must be distributed under a different file name so users can tell an original from an altered version.

nodes.label: LPPL maintainer role
nodes.rationale: Markus Kohm is the maintainer designated by the LPPL, so changes to the original are only permitted through official releases by him. Spin-off projects have their own maintainers and their own licence statements.
nodes.community_name: KOMA-Script book (7th edition, Lehmanns Media / Edition DANTE)

nodes.label: Minimal working example (MWE)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: The smallest possible *working* document that reproduces the problem. A preamble alone or a file needing edits does not count. It lets the author run tests, gauge the asker's experience level, and avoid unnecessary discussion; without one, the best possible answer may be no answer.
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: Frank Neukam
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Author of Script 2.0 and the person who made its design and implementation decisions, which KOMA-Script then deliberately inherited.

nodes.label: Why the default settings are what they are
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Defaults were chosen in 1993 to stay as compatible as possible with Script 2.0, and later features inherited whatever had previously been hard-coded. Compatibility was a guiding rule, though the author later found other package authors care little about it. An attempted change of the header default from \slshape to \itshape in the 1990s drew such protest that it was reverted in the next release, which is why even well-founded change requests are now weighed twice.
nodes.norm_label: why the default settings are what they are

nodes.label: fontsize in \documentclass vs. \KOMAoptions
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: size<size>.clo files load only via \documentclass because KOMA-Script cannot control their external contents and they often fail to load later. Changing the base font size after class loading also cannot retro-fit lengths, since whether a length depended on the base size is not recoverable once it is set.

nodes.label: Privacy (EN)
nodes.community_name: No cookies, no tracking, no external resources

nodes.label: No cookies, no tracking, no external resources
nodes.rationale: Fonts, scripts, images and stylesheets are served exclusively from the site's own server, so merely visiting the page transmits nothing to third parties. External services are reached only when the user actively clicks a link. The theme preference lives in browser localStorage and is covered by § 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG as strictly necessary.
nodes.norm_label: no cookies, no tracking, no external resources
nodes.community_name: No cookies, no tracking, no external resources

nodes.label: Pre-launch HTTP Basic authentication
nodes.rationale: During the pre-launch phase the whole site is behind HTTP Basic auth. Credentials are checked only against a server-side password file and not stored beyond that; the username may appear in server logs and is subject to the 14-day retention. The mechanism is removed at public launch.
nodes.community_name: No cookies, no tracking, no external resources

nodes.community_name: No cookies, no tracking, no external resources

nodes.rationale: Acts as Auftragsverarbeiter under a data processing agreement; server logs are processed on the legitimate-interest basis of Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR.

nodes.label: How much does komascript.de cost? (2010-02-01)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: komascript.de was financed and administered by a handful of private individuals who derived almost no personal benefit from it, which is part of why the burden eventually became untenable.

nodes.label: Where on the page was the index entry created? (2011-05-28)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.norm_label: where on the page was the index entry created? (2011-05-28)

nodes.label: luaindex
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Does not sort page numbers but assumes they are written to the index in the correct order, which makes extending it for positional index markers comparatively simple.

nodes.label: MakeIndex
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Cannot handle extra positional information appended to page numbers, which forces the marker to be smuggled through page-number formatting instead and breaks \index{foo|textbf} and hyperref's hyperpage.

nodes.label: KOMA wish list
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Deliberately kept low-key rather than advertised prominently, because the work is done voluntarily and the author does not want the site to read as a donation appeal.

nodes.label: Why hasn't there been a new KOMA-Script in a year? (2013-07-24)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.norm_label: why hasn't there been a new koma-script in a year? (2013-07-24)
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: Release delay through lack of beta testers
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: The author's own documents no longer exercise new features, and the long-time beta testers are either in the same position or too busy and too proficient to stumble over unclear documentation. Development continues but is too untested to release without triggering a support wave.
nodes.norm_label: release delay through lack of beta testers
nodes.community_name: Splitting the bundle into smaller projects (since 2018)

nodes.label: The new Blog is online (2026-06-26)
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Old posts from the German-only Documentation Project blog will not be translated apart from rare exceptions, and new posts appear in English only exceptionally.

nodes.label: Fuse.js search
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Search index is generated statically at build time so full-text search survives the removal of the dynamic CMS. It does not work on the SourceForge mirror because of a web server limitation.

nodes.label: Move from dynamic CMS to static pages
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Dropping the SQL/PHP CMS layer removes the entry points that had been under sustained brute-force attack on the admin account, ends the dependency on specific PHP versions, delivers pages faster, and makes the site trivially mirrorable. The accepted cost is losing page-view statistics.
nodes.norm_label: move from dynamic cms to static pages

nodes.label: SourceForge mirror of the site
nodes.author: Markus Kohm
nodes.rationale: Possible only because the pages are static, but the mirror cannot run the search function and offers no custom error pages.
